verdicts.why: MCU wiki: Morgan leads her coven of witches in S3 (inducts Nico at the Wizard party) and Robert names her CEO of Wizard Computers; affiliation 'Morgan le Fay's Coven, Wizard (formerly)'. The group is named plainly by the source and Wizard is an existing group.

Osborn hires then fires him, he works for the Kingpin, then when Fisk will not pay he goes back to Norman for new weapons (Marvel DB: 'returned to Norman'), before declaring himself Kingpin and being driven off by Fisk and Osborn together. The proposal names that return in its evidence but leaves out the second Oscorp stage.

Marvel DB team page: after the Chameleon's betrayal and the Doomsday complex collapse (S5E2-6) the rest of the Six disband, status Defunct. Fisk carries on as Kingpin, so his own empire is the right final stage, as after the first disbanding.

Marvel DB and Wikipedia S1E8-9: the Kingpin hires the Shocker (on Smythe's recommendation) to kill Brock and recover the Promethium X, before jail and the Chameleon's breakout into the Insidious Six (S2E1). That matches how the record already treats the later S4E6 hire as Fisk's Empire.

Marvel DB: Otto worked at Tricorp 'for some time' and Tricorp kept the Megalopack 'when he left'. He is already Osborn's Oscorp scientist in the series, and later breaks into Tricorp only to steal it. Tricorp is backstory.

Marvel DB: in S2E13 Norman fakes his death and flies to the Cayman Islands as 'Mr. Roman'. Affiliation 'Formerly: Oscorp', occupation Fugitive, 'Formerly: founder/owner of Oscorp'. He abandons the company alive, so this is a real exit and not a death.

Marvel DB: Marko's Army service was in WWI, fifteen years before the series, where he is already Silvermane's enforcer and Cat Hardy's bodyguard. Silvermane is killed in episode 8 and Flint leaves with Cat, so the Independent stage holds.

Marvel DB: Leyden's Army service was in WWI. In the series he is a lone jewel thief until Silvermane springs him from custody (episode 5), and he dies under a train in episode 8 still in the crime ring. U.S. Army is backstory.

Wikipedia S1E5: Octavius is introduced as 'a former associate of Norman's' who sells his own tech to criminals. MCU wiki: he 'defected from Oscorp', affiliation Oscorp (formerly). He never rejoins, so Oscorp is backstory and no stage is left.

MCU wiki: Pyro was one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen in the Void, 'one of her most valuable lieutenants', while secretly informing for Paradox until she killed him. Affiliation: Cassandra Nova's Henchmen (undercover; formerly). The group is named plainly by the MCU wiki's organization page.
MCU wiki: affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen. The Void Sabretooth is in her crew and is killed by Wolverine. The first title replaces '(from the start)' now that there are two stages.
MCU wiki: affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen. The group page says Toad captured Deadpool and Wolverine for her, and he dies in the raid on her lair.

MCU wiki: affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen (Cain Marko is listed as a member). His first title is X-Men: The Last Stand, where Magneto frees him into the Brotherhood, so that title replaces '(from the start)'.
MCU wiki: affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen, and Callisto is on the group page's member list in Deadpool & Wolverine. Appending the stage after the existing ones is right.
MCU wiki: affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen, and Azazel is on the group's member list in the Void.
MCU wiki: affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen, and Yuriko Oyama is on the member list. In X2 she is only Stryker's controlled enforcer, so nothing is added there.

MCU wiki: her S.H.I.E.L.D. service ended in 2006, when she was captured on Vanchat's gulag raid and presumed dead. In Eye-Spy she is a 'former' agent (title 'Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. (formerly)'), and being taken into custody at the end is not a rejoin. S.H.I.E.L.D. is backstory.

MCU wiki: 'former Marine... fell off the grid in 2008', affiliation USMC (formerly), then recruited into the Clairvoyant's Centipede Project (HYDRA). His first appearance is in prison in AoS episode 5, still years after the USMC, so it is backstory.

MCU wiki: he served in the Soviet 478th Rifle Division and was declared dead in 1944. Dooley only uncovers this after his death (episode 4), so the Soviet service is backstory. Leviathan to Independent is kept as the record has it (the wiki infobox lists Leviathan without 'formerly').

MCU wiki: after the conflict M'Baku joined the Tribal Council for the Jabari, 'ending the centuries of self isolation the Jabari had from the rest of Wakanda'. Affiliation: Jabari Tribe, Tribal Council. This matches the A:m-baku file.

Wikipedia: in episode 7 the board ousts Rand, Ward and Joy, and in episode 10 Joy's blackmail gets the Meachums reinstated. So the exit and return are right, although they come in episodes 7 and 10, not 8 and 13. '(from the start)' must become 'Iron Fist S1' because he now has more than one stage.

Wikipedia Daredevil S2: 'Nelson and Murdock agree to part ways' (episode 9), and Foggy joins Hogarth's firm (episode 13). The firm stays closed through The Defenders until Nelson, Murdock & Page in S3.

MCU wiki: she attended MIT, graduated in 2028 and moved back to New York 'to find employment', skipping a job interview, so she has left the donut shop. MIT is a school the record does not track as a group (it is not in the group list), so per the rules it is dropped and only the exit is kept.

Marvel DB: in S1E3 'a shell-shocked Storm decided to leave the team', and she returns after regaining her powers (S1E6) to fight in the Genosha arc. The stages are right, but 'left' uses 'X-Men '97' when the records' season form is 'X-Men '97 S1', as the proposal's own stages use.
